_comment: RUBRIC v2 section 2.2, applied at gold assembly and nowhere else.
Six reviews, every one of them 3 stars with no actionable body. All six are overlap rows where
the two labelers differed, and all six differed the SAME way: the owner labeled before section
2.2 existed and called them NEEDS_ATTENTION, the annotator labeled after it and called them
WATCH. The product owner adjudicated all six to WATCH on the rubric, not row by row.
What this file does NOT do. It does not edit either labeler raw answers, and it does not touch
the agreement figures: binary kappa 0.614 over 30 overlap rows was computed from the raw answers
before any of this was applied, and it stands. A tier here is the tier that reaches gold.
A fingerprint and a tier. No reasoning per review — the reasoning is section 2.2, which is about
the rule. The reason code and tags on an adjudicated row stay the owner own, per section 7.5,
which makes the owner the adjudicating role.
